notes.title: LESSONS UPDATE
notes.notes:
A week after the official release, i am happy to introduce the [b]Lessons Update[/b] content with [b]Steam Achievements[/b]. A lot of PamPam students asked for it.. it is now available for everyone!

[h1]LESSONS GAME MODE[/h1]

+ Students can now enjoy the [b]Lessons game mode[/b]. You will have to choose between basic Hiragana or Katakana. There is different lessons and every new lessons add previous Kanas.

[h1]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1]

+ Added 12 in-game [b]Steam achievements![/b]

[h1]EMOTES[/h1]

+ [b]Emotes [/b] are here to improve good and bad answers with a smooth animation effect.

[h1]CHANGES AND FIXES[/h1]

+ The menu and settings had some modifications to welcome the Lessons game mode.
+ Added new background for settings
+ Added a new song for the menu
+ Added new Emotes for bad and good answers
+ Fixed random songs on menu selection screen, now songs depend on game modes
+ Fixed shaders issue on teachers
